title: Second part (2 parts)
spec:
Create a new coordinate system for the first part with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face, starting with the first loop that consists of four lines: the first line starts at (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.75, 0.0); the second line starts at (0.75, 0.0) and ends at (0.75, 0.3125); the third line starts at (0.75, 0.3125) and ends at (0.0, 0.3125); the fourth line starts at (0.0, 0.3125) and ends at (0.0, 0.0). Scale the two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.75. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions using the same Euler angles and translation vector. Extrude the sketch 0.0167 units along the normal direction and 0.0 units in the opposite direction to create a solid body. The dimensions of the first part are: length of 0.75, width of 0.3125, and height of 0.016666666666666666.

For the second part, create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector of (0.0167, 0.0167, 0.0167). Draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face, starting with the first loop that consists of four lines: the first line starts at (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.175, 0.0); the second line starts at (0.175, 0.0) and ends at (0.175, 0.1792); the third line starts at (0.175, 0.1792) and ends at (0.0, 0.1792); the fourth line starts at (0.0, 0.1792) and ends at (0.0, 0.0). Repeat this process for seven additional faces, each with its own loop and lines. Scale the two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.7167. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions using the same Euler angles and translation vector. Extrude the sketch 0.0 units along the normal direction and 0.0167 units in the opposite direction to cut material from the existing body. The dimensions of the second part are: length of 0.7166666666666666, width of 0.27916666666666656, and height of 0.016666666666666666.

part_1 = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0.3125).lineTo(0, 0.3125).close().extrude(0.0167)

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the outer rectangle
r = r.box(0.75, 0.3125, 0.0167, centered=(False, False, False))

# Define the inner rectangles
inner_rectangles = [
    (0.0167, 0.0167, 0.1667, 0.2188),
    (0.1875, 0.0167, 0.4167, 0.2188),
    (0.5333, 0.0167, 0.1667, 0.2188),
    (0.0167, 0.2344, 0.0833, 0.0833),
    (0.125, 0.2344, 0.0833, 0.0833),
    (0.1875, 0.2344, 0.375, 0.0833),
    (0.5333, 0.2344, 0.0833, 0.0833),
    (0.6, 0.2344, 0.0833, 0.0833)
]

# Cut the inner rectangles from the outer rectangle
for x, y, w, h in inner_rectangles:
    r = r.cut(cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(x, y).lineTo(x + w, y).lineTo(x + w, y + h).lineTo(x, y + h).close().extrude(0.0167))

# Final model
r = r

import cadquery as cq

X, Y, Z = 0.75, 0.3125, 0.0167
t = 0.022  # member thickness

# Outer plate
r = cq.Workplane("XY").box(X, Y, Z, centered=(False, False, False))

# Opening helper
def cut_box(x0, y0, x1, y1):
    global r
    cutter = cq.Workplane("XY").transformed(offset=(x0, y0, -0.01)) \
        .box(x1 - x0, y1 - y0, Z + 0.02, centered=(False, False, False))
    r = r.cut(cutter)

# Row boundaries (bottom row, horizontal rib, top row)
yb0, yb1 = t, 0.177          # bottom row openings
yt0, yt1 = 0.199, Y - t      # top row openings

# Vertical ribs running full height at these x positions
vx1 = (0.191, 0.213)
vx2 = (0.552, 0.574)

# Top-row only ribs
tx1 = (0.100, 0.122)
tx2 = (0.636, 0.658)

# Bottom row openings
cut_box(t,    yb0, vx1[0], yb1)
cut_box(vx1[1], yb0, vx2[0], yb1)
cut_box(vx2[1], yb0, X - t, yb1)

# Top row openings
cut_box(t,     yt0, tx1[0], yt1)
cut_box(tx1[1], yt0, vx1[0], yt1)
cut_box(vx1[1], yt0, vx2[0], yt1)
cut_box(vx2[1], yt0, tx2[0], yt1)
cut_box(tx2[1], yt0, X - t, yt1)

import cadquery as cq

X = 0.7500
Y = 0.3125
Z = 0.0167
u = 1.0 / 48.0

r = cq.Solid.makeBox(X, Y, Z, cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))

# Rectangular through-openings, on a 36 x 15 grid (1/48 units)
holes = [
    (1, 1, 10, 9),
    (11, 1, 25, 9),
    (26, 1, 35, 9),
    (1, 10, 5, 14),
    (6, 10, 10, 14),
    (11, 10, 25, 14),
    (26, 10, 30, 14),
    (31, 10, 35, 14),
]

for x1, y1, x2, y2 in holes:
    cutter = cq.Solid.makeBox(
        (x2 - x1) * u,
        (y2 - y1) * u,
        Z + 0.02,
        cq.Vector(x1 * u, y1 * u, -0.01),
    )
    r = r.cut(cutter)
